name: computer-use-browser
title: IRS documents in a browser, for AIs that use a computer
summary: An AI that uses a computer through screenshots, mouse and keyboard opens real IRS PDFs and web pages in Chromium: it finds the right page of a long tax table, follows bookmarks, zooms into small print and carries a worksheet through.
description: Each task puts one to three real Internal Revenue Service documents on a Linux desktop, exactly as the IRS publishes them: the 2025 and 2024 tax tables, the 2025 Form 1040 instructions, Publication 15-T for 2026 and 2025, Schedule 1, Publication 501, and the web editions of Publications 501 and 15-T. The AI opens them in Chromium and works from what the screen shows. It pages through a tax table to the right row, figures payroll withholding with stated Form W-4 settings, carries a worksheet through, finds the line of a form that takes an item, reads small print and charts, counts rows on a page, compares two editions and searches long web pages. Every question states its facts, and none describes a real person. The AI writes its answer to a file or gives it as its final answer. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Tax Table lookups
families.what: The row of the 2025 Tax Table for a stated income and filing status, its page, and the Tax Computation Worksheet above $100,000.

families.name: Wage bracket withholding
families.what: Withholding for a pay period from Publication 15-T's wage bracket tables and Worksheet 2, with stated Form W-4 settings.

families.name: Percentage method withholding
families.what: Worksheet 1A carried through with the annual percentage method tables.

families.name: Worksheets
families.what: Standard deduction charts and worksheets, the qualified dividends tax worksheet with two table lookups, and gaming distribution withholding.

families.name: Lines of a form
families.what: Which line of Schedule 1 takes each stated item of income or adjustment.

families.name: Bookmarks and sections
families.what: Reaching a named section through the PDF's own bookmarks and reading its page and values.

families.name: Small print and charts
families.what: Values from pie charts, footnotes, side-by-side rate schedules and the dense EIC Table.

families.name: Counting on a page
families.what: Counting the rows or lines on a page that meet a stated condition.

families.name: Two editions
families.what: The same table or worksheet in two years' editions, and what changed for stated facts.

families.name: Long web pages
families.what: Find in page and scrolling through IRS web pages without their usual layout.
